skill.summary: Comprehensive security assessment and hardening recommendations platform providing compliance framework guidance and critical control evaluation.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the System Hardening Checklist API.
- Provides comprehensive security assessments and hardening recommendations aligned with leading compliance frameworks (CIS, NIST, ISO 27001).
- Supports endpoints for generating assessment reports, retrieving hardening categories, frameworks, and critical controls.
- Enables gap analysis, scoring, and framework alignment for organizational security posture.
- Flexible pricing plans available, including free and enterprise tiers.
